# `current_time`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
current_time([precision])
```

Returns the current time at the start of query evaluation.
All calls of current_time within the same query return the same value.

current_time - Returns the current time at the start of query evaluation.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.1 and later |
| Arguments | [0, 1] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- current_time, example 1
> SELECT current_time();
-- the result differs on every run
```

```sql
-- current_time, example 2
> SELECT current_time;
-- the result differs on every run
```

```sql
-- current_time, example 3
> SELECT current_time(0);
-- the result differs on every run
```

```sql
-- current_time, example 4
> SELECT current_time(3);
-- the result differs on every run
```

```sql
-- current_time, example 5
> SELECT current_time(1+1);
-- the result differs on every run
```
